selection_rule: Final model = lowest post-calibration log-loss on VAL; ties broken by ECE, then noisy accuracy.
selection_amendment: 2026-11-08: Amendment: final model = Extra Trees (isotonic). Original rule (lowest clean val log-loss) would have picked Gaussian NB isotonic (0.0116 vs 0.0147). Rule changed after seeing results. Over 5 noise seeds (42-46, noise.py 1 sigma, same 330 val rows) ET isotonic vs GNB isotonic: noisy log-loss lower in 5/5 seeds (mean diff -0.49), noisy ECE lower in 5/5, noisy accuracy higher in 4/5. ET isotonic has the lowest mean noisy ECE of the nine variants (0.027) but not the lowest noisy log-loss (ET sigmoid 0.246 vs ET isotonic 0.424 +/- 0.159); ET sigmoid is far worse calibrated on clean data (ECE 0.082 vs 0.008). Caveats: seeds are noise draws on the same val rows, not independent data.
